subject.title: Feature: Message continuation marker for batched input (cost savings)

question: Should OpenClaw add a core marker-controlled continuation ingress feature, expose a plugin/API seam for it, or keep timer-based debounce and collect queueing as the supported batching behavior?
rationale: The requested fix would add config and define model-visible turn boundaries, marker stripping, timeout, media, command, and typing semantics, which require maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Keep as product backlog
options.body: Leave this issue open until a maintainer chooses the core or plugin/API shape for marker-controlled continuation batching.

options.title: Use existing batching only
options.body: Close or update the issue if maintainers decide timer-based inbound debounce and collect queueing are the intended cost-saving UX.

options.title: Move to plugin seam design
options.body: Track only the missing plugin/API hooks if the marker behavior should be implemented outside core.

recommendation.title: Keep as product backlog
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until a maintainer chooses the core or plugin/API shape for marker-controlled continuation batching.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent shared inbound debounce policy history and already reviewed this issue as a maintainer-side product follow-up.
